name: r8-fat512-l-disp
author: solx-loop
description: Explores tile:fat. Probes on the rented B200 (harness CUPTI timing, cold L2) show that cutting the CTA count does not cut time, because the CTA launch and retire cost overlaps with the memory stream. Several rows per thread was always slower: 2/4/8 same-head tokens per half-warp, contiguous or strided, 48-84 registers, gave S/M +0-18% and L +1-10%, because occupancy drops. Bigger CTAs at one row per half-warp: 512 threads (32 rows per CTA, 29-31 regs, 4 CTAs/SM) was L -0.8/-1.0/-1.3% at 4096/662
